title: 第518章 神帝城
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“呵呵，我来和你们解释一下吧，神帝争霸赛是我们大夏国和众多国家研究出来的选拔，我们诸多国家打算通过比武选拔一个最强的存在，让他统治这个地球，这个最强的人就是神帝。参加比赛的人不光有我们大夏国人，还有日国人，朝国人，棒国人，米国人，很多国家都派出强者来参加，因为这件事关系到我们国家的荣耀，所以我才邀请云大师参加，扬我国威。”

“毕竟云大师的情况我也知道，云大师出身昆仑山是修仙者，厉害无比，在大夏国没人是云大师的对手，我认为神帝这个位置，只有云大师能担任。”

白虎看着云峰笑嘻嘻的说道。

“哦，请问我去了有什么好处？”

云峰点了点头，继续询问，正所谓无利不起早，如果没好处他自然是不去的。

“哈哈，好处太多了，如果云大师能在神帝争霸赛击败他国强者，荣获第一，成为神帝，你就是这个星球的主宰，到时候不管是强大的米国，还是该死的日国，所有的国家都奉你为主，所有的一切都是你的，你都统治地球了，这个诱惑还不够大吗？”

白虎哈哈大笑起来，他的话让林家人惊呆了。

成为神帝就能统治地球，拥有地球上的一切，美女，金钱，所有的一切，这个诱惑太大了。

如果云峰成为神帝统治了地球，那么他们林家人自然也是一飞冲天了，因此每个林家人都激动的不行。

“但是这样肯定很危险，到时候参加神帝争霸赛的人肯定很多，很强，能参加争霸赛的都是各国家实力最顶尖的存在，云峰，你还是不要去了，我害怕。”

不过林仙儿却是眉头一皱，她只是想和云峰平平安安的过一辈子，对于什么神帝，成为地球的主人她不稀罕。

她不想因为这件事让云峰出事。

“呵呵，云夫人，正所谓富贵险中求，干什么不冒险呢，只要云大师成为神帝，统治了地球，你也可以成为神后，你就是地球的王后娘娘呢！”

白虎则看着林仙儿笑嘻嘻的道。

“好，我答应你，我三天后去。”

看到林仙儿还想说什么，云峰直接打断了她，成为神帝，统治地球对云峰而言还是蛮有诱惑力的。

而且他认为自己应该可以。

毕竟修仙界都被他统治了，再统治地球也不是难事。

地球上强者再强，能有修仙界的那些人强吗？

“那好了，三天后我在神帝城恭候大驾。”

白虎微笑道，身子化为了一道流光飞走了，消失掉了。

云峰也拉着林仙儿和女儿，回到了卧室里。

至于混天大圣和二师姐马蓉，也各自被林家人安排了屋子住下了。

“哎，你又要走了。”

回到卧室后，林仙儿则抱住了云峰大哭起来，哭的很伤心。

她不想云峰离开，但是云峰每次回到家不久又要走，不是去参加这个，就是参加那个。

不过她也知道，毕竟实力越强，责任越大。

云峰如此强大，自然要为官方出力。

这次神帝争霸赛对大夏国异常重要，云峰只能出战。

“没事的，等我成为了神帝，统治了地球，然后带你云游世界，别哭了，多大的人还哭。”

云峰笑嘻嘻的道，拿出了纸巾给林仙儿擦拭脸上的眼泪。

“好的，不过你打算带谁去？”

林仙儿也知道没办法劝慰云峰了，则询问云峰打算带几个人去。

“我打算带混天大圣和二师姐去，毕竟请帖上名额只有三个人。”

云峰想了想则说道，比起林家人而言，二师姐马蓉和混天大圣的实力要强一些，带着他们去参加神帝争霸赛自然最好，说不定大圣和二师姐也能帮他一点小忙什么的。

“知道了，我等你回来。”

林仙儿点了点头，不再废话了。

另外一边，米国天使神族。

作为米国最强大的神族，天使神族一直是无敌的存在，天使族盛产天使，天使的实力和翅膀有关系，翅膀越多实力越强。

"Haha, let me explain to you. The God-Emperor Tournament is a selection researched by Daxia and many other countries. Many of our countries intend to select the strongest being through competitions and let him rule the earth. This strongest person is the God-Emperor.The people participating in the competition are not only people from Daxia, but also people from Japan, Korea, Bang, and the United States. Many countries have sent strong people to participate.Because this matter is related to the glory of our country, I invited Master Yun to participate to promote our country’s prestige.”

"After all, I also know the situation of Master Yun. Master Yun was born in Kunlun Mountain and is an immortal cultivator. He is extremely powerful. No one in Daxia Kingdom can be Master Yun's opponent. I think only Master Yun can hold the position of God Emperor."

Bai Hu looked at Yunfeng and said with a smile.

"Oh, what's the benefit of me going?"

Yunfeng nodded and continued to ask. As the saying goes, if there is no benefit, he will not go early. If there is no benefit, he will not go.

"Haha, there are so many benefits. If Master Yun can defeat the powerful men from other countries in the God-Emperor Competition, win first place, and become the God-Emperor, you will be the master of this planet. By then, whether it is the powerful United States or the damned Japan, all countries will regard you as their master. Everything will be yours. You will rule the earth. Isn't this temptation big enough?"

Bai Hu burst out laughing, and his words shocked the Lin family.

Becoming a god emperor can rule the earth and have everything on the earth, beauties, money, everything. This temptation is too great.

If Yunfeng became the God Emperor and ruled the earth, then the Lin family would naturally soar into the sky, so every Lin family member was extremely excited.

"But this is definitely very dangerous. There will definitely be many and very strong people participating in the God-Emperor Tournament. Those who can participate in the tournament are the most powerful beings from each country. Yunfeng, you'd better not go, I'm afraid."

However, Lin Xianer frowned. She just wanted to live a peaceful life with Yunfeng. She was not shy about some god-emperor becoming the master of the earth.

She didn't want anything to happen to Yunfeng because of this incident.

"Haha, Madam Yun, as the saying goes, wealth can be found in danger, why not take risks? As long as Master Yun becomes the God Emperor and rules the earth, you can also become the God Queen. You will be the Queen of the Earth!"

Bai Hu looked at Lin Xian'er and said with a smile.

"Okay, I promise you, I will go in three days."

Seeing what Lin Xianer wanted to say, Yunfeng interrupted her directly. Becoming a god emperor and ruling the earth was quite tempting to Yunfeng.

And he thinks he should be able to.

After all, the world of immortality is ruled by him, and it will not be difficult to rule the earth again.

No matter how strong the people on earth are, can they be as strong as those in the world of cultivating immortals?

"Okay then, I'll be waiting for you at the Divine Emperor City in three days."

Bai Hu smiled, and his body turned into a stream of light and flew away, disappearing.

Yunfeng also took Lin Xianer and his daughter back to the bedroom.

As for the Great Sage Huntian and the second senior sister Ma Rong, they were also arranged to stay in their respective houses by the Lin family.

"Hey, you're leaving again."

After returning to the bedroom, Lin Xianer hugged Yunfeng and cried loudly, crying very sadly.

She didn't want Yunfeng to leave, but Yunfeng had to leave soon after returning home, either to attend one event or another.

But she also knows that after all, with greater strength comes greater responsibility.

Yunfeng is so powerful, so he naturally wants to contribute to the officialdom.

This God-Emperor Tournament is extremely important to Daxia, so Yunfeng has no choice but to participate.

"It's okay. When I become the God Emperor, rule the earth, and then take you to travel around the world, don't cry. How old are you to cry?"

Yunfeng said with a smile, and took out a tissue to wipe the tears on Lin Xianer's face.

"Okay, but who are you going to take?"

Lin Xianer also knew that there was nothing she could do to comfort Yunfeng, so she asked Yunfeng how many people he planned to take with him.

"I plan to take the Great Sage Huntian and Second Senior Sister there. After all, there are only three places on the invitation."

Yunfeng thought for a while and said that compared to the Lin family, the second senior sister Ma Rong and the Great Sage Huntian were stronger. It would be best to take them to participate in the God-Emperor Tournament. Maybe the Great Sage and the second senior sister could also help him a little bit.

"I know, I'll wait for you to come back."

Lin Xian'er nodded and stopped talking nonsense.

On the other side, there is the Angel Protoss of the United States.

As the most powerful protoss in the United States, the angel protoss has always been an invincible existence. The angel race is rich in angels. The strength of angels is related to their wings. The more wings, the stronger they are.
